title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in India.**
As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency.
* Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity.
* Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops.
* Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities.
* Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics.
* Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices.
* Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures.
* Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls.
* Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems.
* Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior.
* Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance.

**Requirements**

* Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems.
* Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution.
* Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads.
* Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions.
* Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly in a distributed team.
* Availability to overlap with US Central Time business hours for at least three hours each day.
* Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and their applications in AI evaluation and similarity-based testing.
* Experience with load testing non-deterministic endpoints and assessing system behavior under varying workloads.
* A proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently, adapt to evolving technologies, and continuously improve testing methodologies.

description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

**Do**

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

title: Artificial Intelligence Consultant
description:
**THIS IS A LONG TERM CONTRACT POSITION WITH ONE OF THE LARGEST GLOBAL TECHNOLOGY LEADERS.**

**About the Role**

Our client is looking for an experienced
**AI/ML Engineer**
to build enterprise-grade chatbots and intelligent assistants using state-of-the-art
**LLM and Generative AI technologies**
.

The role focuses on
**finance data, RAG-based architectures, hallucination mitigation, and agentic AI systems**
deployed at scale. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Platform teams to deliver reliable, explainable, and production-ready AI solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

* 5–7 years of relevant professional experience in
  **AI/ML Engineering**
  .
* Strong hands-on programming experience with
  **Python and SQL**
  .
* Experience building
  **LLM-powered applications, chatbots, or intelligent assistants**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **RAG architectures**
  , retrieval pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Experience with LLMs such as
  **OpenAI GPT, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama**
  .
* Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as
  **LangChain and/or LangGraph**
  .
* Understanding of
  **tool calling, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures, and multi-step AI workflows**
  .
* Experience implementing techniques to reduce LLM hallucinations, including
  **grounding, re-ranking, citations, and confidence scoring**
  .
* Experience deploying and monitoring AI/ML applications using
  **cloud and MLOps practices**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS**
  services such as S3, EC2, ECS, Lambda, SageMaker, or CodePipeline.
* Experience implementing
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  for AI/ML applications and inference services.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured enterprise data.
* Strong understanding of LLM evaluation, prompt/version management, and AI observability.

Key Responsibilities

* Build
  **LLM-powered chatbots and intelligent assistants**
  using OpenAI, RAG, tool calling, and agent frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
* Design
  **Agent-to-Agent (A2A) architectures**
  for multi-step reasoning and autonomous workflows.
* Design and implement retrieval pipelines using
  **embeddings, vector databases, hybrid search, and cross-encoders**
  .
* Implement hallucination mitigation techniques including
  **grounding, re-ranking, citations, and confidence scoring**
  .
* Work with finance and enterprise datasets while ensuring
  **accuracy, reliability, and data governance**
  .
* Deploy, monitor, and operate AI systems using
  **cloud-native and MLOps practices**
  .
* Implement and maintain
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  for AI pipelines and inference services.
* Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks for measuring the quality and reliability of LLM applications.
* Apply observability and evaluation tools such as
  **LangSmith, MLflow, and Weights & Biases**
  .
* Work with data platforms and pipelines involving
  **Snowflake, DBT, structured data, and unstructured data**
  .
* Collaborate with Product, Data, and Platform teams to deliver scalable, explainable, and production-ready AI solutions.

Our large, Fortune Technology client is ranked as one of the best companies to work with, in the world. As a global leader in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, they foster progressive culture, creativity, and a flexible work environment. They use cutting-edge technologies to keep themselves ahead of the curve. Diversity in all aspects is respected. Integrity, experience, honesty, people, humanity, and passion for excellence are some other adjectives that define this global technology leader.

Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

**Do**

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

2. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development

* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders

͏

3. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution

* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

͏

**Deliver**

**No.**
**Performance Parameter**
**Measure**
1.Continuous Integration, Deployment & Monitoring of Software100% error free on boarding & implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan2.Quality & CSATOn-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation3.MIS & Reporting100% on time MIS & report generation

Mandatory Skills: Oracle SOA Suite
  
.

Experience: 5-8 Years
  
.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
description:
Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead at Monay

Location: Kakinada or Hyderabad, India

Work arrangement: On-site, full-time

Monay is building two connected products: a wallet for enterprise and consumer payments, and a blockchain settlement layer that links payments to invoices and records confirmed money movement.

We need a strong engineer who can lead a small team in India and write production code every week. You’ll work directly with our US-based founder and team, make technical decisions and take responsibility for getting features delivered.

What the role involves

You’ll lead and mentor 3–5 engineers across Monay Wallet and Monay Blockchain. The work includes wallet applications, backend services, ledger integrations and smart contracts.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Next.js, React Native with Expo, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Rust, TigerBeetle and Solidity. We use Foundry, Hardhat and Arbitrum Orbit/Stylus across the blockchain work.

You’ll be expected to:

• Take features from specification through implementation, testing and release.

• Review code carefully and keep pull requests small enough to review properly.

• Protect payment and ledger correctness as the products grow.

• Use Claude Code or comparable AI coding agents daily, and verify what they produce.

• Help your team solve problems, improve their work and meet commitments.

• Raise blockers early and take the initiative to resolve them.

Who we’re looking for

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers.

• Strong, current coding skills in TypeScript/Node.js or Rust, with a willingness to work in both.

• Practical experience with AI coding agents in everyday engineering.

• Exposure to Ethereum/EVM, Solidity and smart contract tooling.

• A solid understanding of APIs, relational databases and testing.

• Clear written English and dependable communication.

• A record of taking ownership and finishing difficult work without constant supervision.

Payments, fintech, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, wallet integrations, TigerBeetle or Arbitrum experience would be useful.

Please read this before applying

This is a demanding startup role. It is not a routine 8-to-5 position where responsibility ends when the working day does. There will be tight deadlines, difficult problems and periods that require additional effort to get a release over the line.

We’re looking for someone dedicated, focused and highly motivated. You should be comfortable starting work without waiting for detailed instructions, making decisions and being accountable for the result.

Commitment means delivering consistently, helping the team and maintaining quality when the pressure is on. We care about what you accomplish and whether people can depend on you.

Employment and stock options

You’ll initially be employed by Tilli Software India. The role will move to Monay India once the local entity is established.

After two years, you may qualify for Monay stock options based on your dedication, performance, leadership and consistency. Eligibility and any grant are subject to review, approval and the terms of Monay’s stock option plan. Completing two years does not automatically qualify you for a grant.

You’ll have the opportunity to help build our India engineering team and earn greater responsibility as the company grows.

How to apply

Send your CV to both hr@tilli.pro and talent@Monay.com, along with links to code you’ve written and a short note telling us:

• About a difficult feature or product you personally delivered.

• How you use Claude Code or other AI coding agents.

• Why this kind of role appeals to you.

• Whether you prefer Kakinada or Hyderabad.

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing
  **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with
  **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a
  **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**
  , ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Competitive compensation:**
  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:**
  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**
  up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy.
* **Comprehensive health insurance:**
  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.
* **Enhanced family leave:**
  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.
* **Learning & growth:**
  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.
